truthBoundary: This contract defines the fresh-clone readiness requirements for SEIS AI. It does not perform a network clone, install models, download checkpoints, train models, run inference, call providers, provision cloud/GPU resources, execute SSH, push, merge, deploy, release, grant runtime authority, or prove AGI.

githubPublicReadinessBaseline.requirement: README explains what the project does, why it is useful, how to get started, where to get help, and contribution expectations.
githubPublicReadinessBaseline.seisCheck: README must mention Local Demo, no-key AI mode, AI public readiness, and the one-command readiness validator.

githubPublicReadinessBaseline.requirement: Public users need a security policy and vulnerability reporting path.
githubPublicReadinessBaseline.seisCheck: SECURITY.md must exist and AI readiness must block secrets, provider keys, SSH keys, and release without approval.

githubPublicReadinessBaseline.requirement: Code scanning and secret protection are part of repository security readiness.
githubPublicReadinessBaseline.seisCheck: AI fresh-clone readiness must require secret scanning, push protection, code scanning, and dependency review before everyone-ready release.

requiredBeforeFreshCloneVerified: fresh clone created from the target commit
npm run check:seis-ai-public-readiness passes in the clone
human reviewer records the target commit and environment
requiredBeforeGithubReadyForEveryone: all freshCloneAcceptanceGates are satisfied or explicitly approved
all required CI checks green on the target commit
release notes and rollback plan accepted
forbiddenClaims: Local Demo is a trained 512B model.
A passing readiness validator grants runtime authority.
A public README can replace model cards, dataset cards, benchmark reports, or training logs.
nextSafeActions: Run npm run check:seis-ai-fresh-clone-readiness before changing AI public readiness claims.
Record a real fresh-clone evidence report only after the target commit is selected.
Keep githubReadyForEveryone false until fresh-clone evidence, CI, security, release notes, rollback, and human approval exist.
